content.title: APPENDIX 1. CONTINUED
content.description: The document displays the relationships of committee members with industry or other entities relevant to the guideline. The table includes employment positions, consultancy roles, speaking arrangements, ownership interests, personal research affiliations, and other financial benefits.
content.note: The relationships were reviewed and updated with all meetings and calls of the writing committee during the document development process. It does not necessarily reflect total relationships with industry at the time of publication.
